title: Sloping
summary: SLO'PING, participle present tense 1. Taking an inclined direction. 2. adjective Oblique; declivous; inclining or inclined from a horizontal of other right line.

inlines.v: SLO'PING, participle present tense 1. Taking an inclined direction. 2. adjective Oblique; declivous; inclining or inclined from a horizontal of other right line.
